description: Use this when the user has a photo of an item they want to sell or list (eBay, Shopify, Etsy, a marketplace post) and wants a listing draft from it. Pass the photo as file, image_url (a public https link) or image_base64. Returns the product type, the brand and model only when printed on the item (a brand guessed from the design comes apart as likely_brand, marked as a guess), colour, material, visible wear, items shown with it, a title under 80 characters, bullet points, and what to ask the seller. One JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC image up to 8 MB. It never invents a model number, a size or a condition grade. The photo goes once to a free Google Gemini model and nothing is kept. Not for photos of people, or for checking whether an item is genuine.

file.description: The product photo the user attached in the chat.

download_url.description: Temporary link to the uploaded file.

image_base64.description: The photo bytes as base64 (a data: URL is accepted), up to 8 MB.

image_url.description: A public https link to one JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo, up to 8 MB, of the item alone: a photo with a person in it, such as clothing being worn, is refused, so ask for the item laid flat. Send exactly one of file, image_url and image_base64. Example call: {"image_url": "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e6/Leica_M6_TTL_front.jpg"}

name: describe_product_photo

ask_seller.description: What the photo cannot show, to ask the seller: serial number, whether it works, size, age.

brand.description: Only when printed or clearly legible on the item.

likely_brand.description: A brand (and model line) guessed from the design because none is printed: a guess for the seller to confirm, never a fact for the listing.

model.description: Only when printed or clearly legible on the item.

printed_text.description: The text the model read on the item; brand and model are checked against it.

title: Draft a listing from a product photo
